hardware_baseline.default_home_optimization_baseline: On Xiaomi MiTV-ASTP0 (Android 9, 22.8.30.1385) with candidate b7ef6b0 standard APK (dd33307f...): system HOME remained com.mitv.tvhome/.MainActivityUserMode; ADB simulated Home from third-party app returned to Marco attributed as OEM window fallback; short standby (~25s) and ~3-min standby returned focus to Marco (~5.5s / ~6s); physical remote Home and D-pad were confirmed on-site; AC power-unplug cold boot round 696 auto-arrived at Marco without remote input (user did not observe first operable desktop, round 695 first showed OEM launcher with ADB initially off); caveats preserved: standby from Android TV Settings also returned to Marco (~5s), 37 HomeSetupDeviceChecks UI checks passed while full command exited 1 due to post-test DEAD accessibility binding (recovered after re-enabling compat in UI). Final 0.21.3 adds two small host-verified fixes (task bridge --stop mixed PID reporting and preserving user-disabled boot_home on native HOME routine checks) on top of b7ef6b0; final 0.21.3 APK was not separately re-installed on TV.
hardware_baseline.task_bridge_api23_compat_fix: 0.21.2-0.21.3 host-verified via 18 cross-API reflection checks (API 23-35+), MiTV4 header-only ps -A fallback to plain ps, cmdline identity states, and CLI --stop mixed verified/unreadable PID reporting; physical Android 6.0-7.1 TV retest pending
hardware_baseline.packaging_compatibility_fix: normalized PKZIP extract_version (10/20) across all APK entries, declared required=false for implied wifi/location/landscape features, switched label to @string/app_name, explicit v1/v2/v3 signing with min-sdk-version 23, and verified overwrite install on MiTV-ASTP0
hardware_baseline.brand_unification_and_app_management: verified official Purple Stacked Cards multi-density icons, API 26 adaptive icon, TV banners, animated 3-layer header & settings brand emblem, lilac/lavender focus accents, centralized App Management & Uninstall panel with 4-way filters, All Apps drawer long-press full menu, and direct desktop card uninstall on MiTV-ASTP0
hardware_baseline.header_icons_and_per_card_customization: verified 4-icon spring focus animations without 'by Pilipala' subtitle, widened downward card-row threshold, cached Gaussian blur shadows, per-card custom width/height/3D depth/radius with full-height 3D live preview on TV inputs & app cards, and phone QR cover upload flow on MiTV-ASTP0
hardware_baseline.cloud_4k_live_wallpaper_and_dlna: verified cloud 4K 60fps live wallpaper playback (including Pixar tabby cat preset), slimmed APK (~1.22 MB), non-flashing desktop return, and Bonjour mDNS / DLNA discovery enhancements on MiTV-ASTP0
hardware_baseline.standby_wake_recovery: verified on MiTV-ASTP0 after Xiaomi gotoSleepStayAliveProcess forceStopPackage
